headline: Special permits for a sign at 141 Winthrop Ave and redevelopment at 539-557 Common St.
summary: The meeting covers two special permit petitions: one for internally illuminated signs for a veterinary hospital at 141 Winthrop Ave, and another to redevelop 539-557 Common St into multifamily commercial mixed use. The board will also review the Open Space and Recreation Plan.
items: 141 Winthrop Ave: special permit petition by Persona Services Group for internally illuminated signs for a Veterinary Hospital
539-557 Common St (lots 145-0-15, 145-0-16, & 145-0-7): special permit petition by AYJ Common St LLC to redevelop the site into multifamily commercial mixed use
Open Space and Recreation Plan - review and discussion

LAWRENCE PLANNING BOARD 
PUBLIC HEARING 
 
Wednesday, October 7, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
255 Essex Street, Lawrence, MA 01840 
 
Continued Case 
N/A 
New Business 
 
 141 Winthrop Ave- located in a B-1 Business Zoning District. Petition of Persona Services 
Group of 11 Azsr Ct, Halethorpe MD, for a special permit pursuant to section 29-11 in 
accordance with 29-20 VII(x)13ii of the Revised Zoning Ordinance of the City of Lawrence 
for the purposes of installing internally illuminated signs for a Veterinary Hospital. 
 
 539-557 Common St (lots 145-0-15, 145-0-16, & 145-0-7) - located in a B-2 Zoning 
District. Petition of AYJ Common St LLC of 2 Pine Tree Dr, Methuen MA, for a special permit 
pursuant to section 29-21 in accordance with 29-23(i)(kk) of the Revised Zoning Ordinance 
of the City of Lawrence for the purposes of redeveloping the site into a multifamily 
commercial mixed use.
